description: This file contains unit tests for the AnySoftKeyboard input method, specifically testing the QuickText feature, including outputting emojis, shifted text, handling backspaces, and UI interactions with quick text views.

classes.name: AnySoftKeyboardQuickTextTest
classes.description: A JUnit test class for testing the QuickText feature of the AnySoftKeyboard input method, including output, shift handling, UI interactions, and input flow behaviors.

methods.name: testOutputTextKeyOutputText
methods.description: Tests that pressing the quick text key outputs the expected emoji and UI updates accordingly.

methods.name: testOutputTextKeyOutputShiftedTextWhenShifted
methods.description: Verifies that when shift is active, the shifted text is output correctly.

methods.name: testOutputTextKeyOutputTextWhenNotShifted
methods.description: Checks that normal text is output when shift is not active.

methods.name: testOutputTextKeyOutputTextWhenShiftedButHasNoShiftedText
methods.description: Ensures that if shift is active but no shifted text is defined, the original text is used.

methods.name: testOutputTextKeyOutputTextWhenShiftLocked
methods.description: Verifies output when shift is locked.

methods.name: testOutputTextKeyOutputTextAndThenBackspace
methods.description: Tests that backspace deletes the output text correctly.

methods.name: testOutputTextKeyOverrideOutputText
methods.description: Checks that overriding default text via preferences works.

methods.name: testOutputTextDeletesOnBackspace
methods.description: Verifies that backspace deletes the output text.

methods.name: testOutputTextDoesNotAutoCorrect
methods.description: Ensures that outputting quick text does not trigger auto-correction.

methods.name: testOutputTextDeletesOnBackspaceWhenSuggestionsOff
methods.description: Checks backspace behavior when suggestions are disabled.

methods.name: testOutputTextDeletesOnBackspaceWithoutSpace
methods.description: Verifies backspace deletes output text when no trailing space.

methods.name: testOutputTextDeletesOnBackspaceWhenSuggestionsOffWithoutSpace
methods.description: Checks backspace behavior with suggestions off and no space.

methods.name: testOutputTextDoesNotDeletesOnBackspaceIfCursorMoves
methods.description: Ensures that moving cursor prevents automatic deletion of output text on backspace.

methods.name: testOutputTextDoesNotDeletesOnBackspaceIfCursorMovesWhenSuggestionsOff
methods.description: Same as above but with suggestions off.

methods.name: testOutputTextDoesNotDeletesOnCharacterIfCursorMoves
methods.description: Verifies that cursor movement prevents deletion when typing characters.

methods.name: testOutputTextKeySwitchKeyboardWhenFlipped
methods.description: Tests that the keyboard switches view when flip setting is enabled and quick text is activated.

methods.name: testPopupTextKeyOutputTextWhenFlipped
methods.description: Checks output when popup quick text key is pressed with flip enabled.

methods.name: testPopupTextKeySwitchKeyboard
methods.description: Verifies that pressing the popup quick text key switches the keyboard view.

methods.name: testSecondPressOnQuickTextKeyDoesNotCloseKeyboard
methods.description: Ensures that pressing quick text key twice does not close the keyboard unexpectedly.

methods.name: testCloseQuickTextKeyboardOnInputReallyFinished
methods.description: Tests that the quick text keyboard closes when input is finished.

methods.name: testCloseQuickTextKeyboardOnFinishInputView
methods.description: Verifies quick text keyboard closure on input view finish.

methods.name: testDoesNotReShowCandidatesIfNoCandidatesToBeginWith
methods.description: Checks that candidate suggestions are not re-shown if none exist initially.

methods.name: testHomeOnQuickTextKeyClosesKeyboard
methods.description: Tests that pressing home (hide window) closes the quick text view.

methods.name: testOutputAsTypingKeyOutput
methods.description: Verifies output when a key is used as a typing key.

methods.name: testOutputAsTypingKeyOutputShifted
methods.description: Checks shifted output for typing keys.

methods.name: testOutputTextKeyOutputTypingAndThenBackspace
methods.description: Tests typing and backspace behavior for output keys.
